scope: Independent validation of taskfs.py command bridge only; no packet, puzzle, prototype, or native verification claims.
execution_context: Approved escalated client connected to a server already running inside an approved private user/mount namespace. No namespaces or mounts created or changed during validation.
limits: The server contains cwd selection; it does not sandbox subprocess file access or argv.
The command bridge does not create mounts or namespaces and grants no permission to access host files or unrelated data.
The tmpfs is ephemeral; assignment and evidence checkpoints must be persisted by the task owner.
Free-space counters are a single filesystem snapshot and do not establish a per-model quota, host byte quota, or sustained availability.
